profile_boundary_decomposition.definition: A = stretched350 - held175plateau (profile); B = held175plateau - single175 (old outer ABC replaced by added region); total=A+B

held_profile_causality.boundary: old ABC at x=-175,875 and y=-875
held_profile_causality.meaning: Matched old profile and mesh imply outer-boundary/added-region causality; finite SEM stencil has tiny numerical precursors, so this is a magnitude check, not exact compact-support equality

double_minus_single.meaning: Magnitude before any continuum P-wave return from the old175 outer boundary; non-negligible values cannot be explained solely by moving that boundary

double_minus_held.meaning: Magnitude before any continuum P-wave return from the old175 outer boundary; non-negligible values cannot be explained solely by moving that boundary

pre_old_boundary_comparison.mask: time < min(left/right/bottom reflected path from source via old175 ABC to receiver)/Vp - 0.003

method.rayleigh_equation: (2-q^2)^2 = 4 sqrt(1-q^2) sqrt(1-(Vs/Vp)^2 q^2), q=cR/Vs; positive nonzero subsonic root
method.rayleigh_derivation: Plane P/S potentials with exp(-a k z), exp(-b k z); zero tangential/normal traction gives determinant above. Used only as a kinematic guide in the undamped homogeneous medium.
method.onset: First 3 consecutive 1ms samples exceeding each stated amplitude threshold; Ricker is not compact in time, so threshold onsets are not exact wavefronts
method.reference_window_peak: Single175 velocity maximum in [0,t0+abs(x-350)/cR+60ms]; a reproducible reference window, not a pure direct-mode separation. Near x=5 direct and boundary-related arrivals can overlap.
method.receiver_gate_caution: after_direct_plus80ms intentionally excludes the initial wave; at near-edge receivers this can also exclude early returning waves, so it is not a measure of all reflected response
method.late_amplitude_caution: RMS and squared velocity sum are amplitude proxies, not elastic energy or true numerical error; no infinite-domain reference was computed
method.differences_caution: Differences between approximate boundary treatments are not true error. Both damping ramp and boundary position change in stretched350; held175plateau isolates moving the old boundary while retaining the old interior coefficients.
